# glpi_group (Data Source)

Look up a GLPI group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glpi_group" "by_name" {
  name = "example"
}

data "glpi_group" "by_id" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) Name of the item. Set id or name; must match exactly one item.

### Read-Only

- `assign` (Boolean) Tickets can be assigned to the group.
- `code` (String) Group code. Needs GLPI 11 or later.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `completename` (String) Full path of the item in its tree, computed by GLPI.
- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `item_group` (Boolean) The group can own items.
- `manager` (Boolean) The group can manage other groups.
- `notify` (Boolean) The group can be notified.
- `parent_id` (Number) ID of the parent. 0 means top level.
- `requester` (Boolean) Members can be ticket requesters.
- `task` (Boolean) The group can be assigned tasks.
- `user_group` (Boolean) The group can contain users.
- `watcher` (Boolean) Members can watch tickets.
